title: 25 hour Main Screen
symptom: The main xDrip screen currently covers 24 hours, but the user often wants to look back at what they did at this time (or a little before) yesterday, to see what they did and how effective it was, or what they did wrong so they don't repeat it. They currently use the history screen but a 25 hour screen might be more convenient.
